declaration.preface:
Fair and equitable wages are essential for employee well-being and sustainable business growth. This Living Wage Policy ensures that all employees receive wages that cover basic living costs, supporting a decent standard of living for them and their families.

A structured approach has been established to determine, implement, and periodically review living wages across all operations. This policy aligns with broader efforts to uphold ethical labor practices, human rights, and social responsibility.

By prioritizing fair compensation, the goal is to create a positive impact within the workforce and the communities in which Allchem operates.
declaration.declaration: Allchem Lifescience Pvt. Ltd. upholds fair compensation practices by ensuring all employees receive a living wage that meets their basic needs and enables a decent standard of living. Using year 2022 as the baseline year, we continuously assess wage structures, implement necessary adjustments, and engage with stakeholders to uphold equitable pay practices across our operations and supply chain.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Allchem employees, including permanent, contractual, and temporary workers. It ensures wages remain aligned with the cost of living through periodic reviews. Suppliers and partners are encouraged to follow similar fair wage practices.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Allchem Lifescience Pvt. Ltd. upholds fair compensation practices by ensuring all employees receive a living wage that meets their basic needs and enables a decent standard of living.

Regularly evaluate wage levels against living wage benchmarks.

Implement necessary revisions to align wages with inflation, cost of living changes, and industry standards.

The HR Department ensures fair wages through periodic assessments and alignment with living wage benchmarks.

This policy applies to all Allchem employees, including permanent, contractual, and temporary workers.

The Living Wage Policy will be reviewed every two years, or sooner if required by the HR Manager, to ensure it remains aligned with inflation rates, cost-of-living changes, industry standards, and regulatory developments.

policy.monitoring:
Annual wage assessments and internal audits will be conducted to evaluate compliance with living wage commitments, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions. Findings will be documented and reported to senior management for review and policy refinement.

Compliance with living wage requirements will be monitored through periodic supplier audits, ensuring key partners align with fair wage principles and corrective actions are taken when necessary.
